name: Kochava
sells: precise geolocation data tied to mobile advertising IDs

optOut.notes: kochava.com/opt-out/ only gives device-level instructions (disable interest-based ads, reset the advertising ID, opt out inside the app). Privacy contact privacy@kochava.com is on the support-privacy page.

signals.value: FTC alleged (2024 second amended complaint) that Kochava collects and shares information on hundreds of millions of consumers
